title: Trail Counting Walk
shareTitle: Trail Counting Walk — A Papercraft Number Adventure
description: Help Pip the paper fox hop across three handmade woodland trails while counting every step to 5, 10, or 20.
learningGoals: Build stable one-to-one correspondence between a touch, an object, and a spoken number
Practice the forward number sequence from 1 to 20
Recognize written numerals while hearing their number names
Sustain attention through short groups of five without pressure or time limits
interactionModel: choose a five-, ten-, or twenty-step trail, then tap the glowing next numbered paper stone to help Pip hop forward
feedbackModel: each accepted touch speaks the number, moves Pip in a readable hop, earns a paper star, and advances the pennant; future stones give a gentle next-number cue without losing progress
